name: nlp-4-mat
description: Interactive 4MAT presentation studio: progressive interview, source-grounded claim ledger, audience and format adaptation, storyboard, production, independent review and rehearsal, with optional evidence-aware NLP communication tools.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an idea, a thesis, research notes or an existing deck into an audience-specific presentation using the 4MAT sequence: Mini What, Why, What, How, What If / What If Not.

The studio reads your material first, asks only the decisions it cannot answer (with a recommended option each time), and keeps a decision log so you can revise one choice without starting over. It builds a claim ledger that separates what exists today from what is planned, illustrative or still a hypothesis, so nothing is overclaimed in front of examiners, investors or your audience.

It adapts structure, proof and the ask to the audience and format: academic defense, investor pitch, interactive workshop with nested cycles, speech without slides, live demo, web or recorded talk. Optional NLP-informed tools (perceptual positions, Disney creative strategy, logical levels, objection reframing, narrative loops, presenter state) are used only when they solve a diagnosed problem, with honest evidence labels. It finishes with an independent critique and rehearsal drills.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn my thesis and notes into a 15-minute 4MAT defense for my examiners.
Review my existing slide deck against the 4MAT structure and tell me what to fix first.
Adapt my presentation into a 5-minute pitch for funders without overclaiming.
